'''Shard''' was an individual who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Priorities" /> which spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> They acted as the leader of Jeht's<ref name="Priorities" /> [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="Last Stand">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20070201LastStand|text=Living Force: Last Stand|int=Living Force: Last Stand}}</ref> At some point during the war, Shard commented on how Jeht seemed more relaxed when he was carrying out work on his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Legacy (Darrus Jeht)|''Legacy'']]&mdash;a sentiment Jeht agreed with.<ref name="Priorities" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shard was mentioned in "[[Priorities]]," an article written by [[August Hahn]] and [[Cynthia Hahn]] as a supplement to the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] campaign. The article was published on the [[Wizards of the Coast]] [[Wizards.com|website]] on [[October 28]], [[2004]].<ref name="Priorities" /> The short story "[[Living Force: Last Stand]]," released on [[February 1]], [[2007]], features a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] leading Darrus Jeht's [[Trooper/Legends|troops]],<ref name="Last Stand" /> which Shard is established to be the leader of in "Priorities."<ref name="Priorities" /> The short story does not provide any indication as to whether this [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] is intended to be Shard.<ref name="Last Stand" />
